### 🌐 Target Language
- **Language Name:** <!-- e.g., Gujarati, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, Bengali -->
- **ISO 639-1 Code:** <!-- e.g., gu, ta, te, kn, bn -->
- **Are you a native speaker or agricultural professional?** Yes / No

### 📋 Contribution Scope
- [ ] Interface and navigation buttons
- [ ] Pesticide toxicity triangle classifications (Red, Yellow, Blue, Green)
- [ ] Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) instructions
- [ ] Dosage and sprayer tank calibration guidelines
- [ ] Emergency medical and poison antidote warnings

### 🛡️ Safety Verification Confirmation
- [ ] I have verified that all numbers, dosages (e.g., ml/L, g/acre), and pre-harvest intervals match the CIBRC source.
- [ ] I confirm that the emergency ingestion warning includes explicit negation (e.g., "do NOT induce vomiting").
- [ ] I have run `npm test` locally to verify that the automated safety regression validator passes.
